title: WPMS/1080/2021 of M/S OSHO INDUSTRIES LTD. Vs ADDITIONAL COLLECTOR FINACE AND REVENUE HARIDWAR

COURT'S OR JUDGES'S ORDERS
WPMS No. 1080 of 2021
Hon'ble Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.
(Through Video Conferencing)
Mr. Arvind Vashistha, Senior Advocate
assisted by Ms. Priyanka Agrawal, Advocate for
the petitioner.
After arguing for some length, the learned
counsel for the petitioner seeks to withdraw the
Writ Petition with a liberty to prefer a Revision
under Section 25 of the Provincial Small Causes
Courts Act, as against the impugned order under
challenged.
Accordingly, the Writ Petition is dismissed
as withdraw with the aforesaid liberty.
It is made clear that the Registry will treat
the caveat of the respondent as to be the caveat
for the proposed Revision to be filed by the
petitioner.
Registry is directed to return the certified
copy of the impugned judgment under challenge
in the Writ Petition to the petitioner by
substituting the same with the zerox copy.
